name: Jonathan Walker
bio: From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia. Jonathan Lloyd Walker (born in Henley-on-Thames, Oxfordshire) is an English actor and Writer, who now resides in Canada. He is well known for film roles in Shooter, RED and most recently as the British radio operator Colin in The Thing (2011 prequel). He also played Rankor in the TV-series Flash Gordon. He was married to award winning documentary film-maker Sheona McDonald. They have three children.
